# Home espresso

Pulling shots on a lever machine in the kitchen. Start with 18 g of finely ground coffee and aim for 36 g in the cup in about 28 seconds; grind finer when the shot runs fast and sour, coarser when it drips slowly and tastes bitter. #baking

Steam whole milk to about 60 °C with the wand tip just under the surface, then sink it to spin the jug until the foam is glossy.
